notes: Manual layout S2 (mars-dawn#432), English, more than 30 pages so contents numbers reach two digits. Cover from the front matter (title, subtitle, version, date, author) with a logo (img/logo.png, one flat colour). The contents lists 8 h1 and 41 h2 and spans two pages or more. Heading texts repeat on purpose (Overview and Checklist in every chapter), so only per-heading markers can place them. Chapter 6 has the calibrated entry ('Calibrating the contents line ... iiii'): with an auto-width number slot and a one-digit placeholder its contents line ends within one 'i' of the line end, and with the two-digit number of pass B it wraps; the fixed-width slot keeps both passes alike (the M2 control). 24 external links and 8 footnotes (fewer than 10: a two-digit footnote number's list marker sits in the left margin, in every layout, which the margin check would report).
